Implementation.initialize initializer-guarded pool flag setup

Bonding.deposit external, pulls LP tokens via transferFrom and stages them
Bonding.withdraw external onlyFrozen, returns staged LP tokens to msg.sender
Bonding.bond external, claims rewards, unfreezes and moves staged to bonded
Bonding.unbond external onlyFrozenOrFluid, moves bonded back to staged
Bonding.provide external, adds liquidity through _addLiquidity and bonds resulting LP
Bonding.claim external, pays pending dollar then updates reward debt
Bonding.addPool external governance-only pool registration
Bonding.step internal epoch advancement using epochTime() derived from block.timestamp
Market.purchaseCoupons external, burns caller dollar and mints coupons with premium
Market.extendCoupon external, burns dollars for debt and re-times coupon expiry
Market.clipCoupons external, converts redeemed coupons into clippable dollar
Market.approveCoupons external, sets coupon allowances
Market.transferCoupons external, moves coupon balances with allowance check
Market.step internal, redeems outstanding coupons for the current epoch
Collateral.redeem external nonReentrant, burns dollar and pays proportional collateral
Collateral.addCollateral external governance-only collateral registration
Govern.vote external, EOA-restricted (msg.sender == tx.origin) governance voting
Govern.commit external, quorum-gated upgradeTo of candidate implementation
Govern.emergencyCommit external, super-majority gated upgradeTo
Govern.canPropose private stake threshold check
Regulator.step internal, captures oracle price and branches to grow/shrink supply

Regulator.shrinkSupply private, raises debt toward the price target

Setters._sellAndDepositCollateral internal, loops pools calling pair.swap
Setters._addLiquidity internal, pulls both tokens and mints LP to the contract

Comptroller.burnFromAccountForDebt internal, transfers in and burns caller dollar

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed to incentivize and minted advance incentive
advance requires msg.sender == tx.origin, an EOA-only gate
block.timestamp is emitted in the Advance event
advance calls incentivize(msg.sender, advanceIncentive)
advance calls Bonding.step()
advance calls Regulator.step()
advance calls Market.step()
advance reads _state.epoch.current for the Advance event
incentivize calls mintToAccount
mintToAccount performs an external dollar().mint call
mintToAccount increases _state.balance.debt
Bonding.step gates on epochTime(), which is derived from block.timestamp
Bonding.step increments _state.epoch.current
Regulator.step branches to growSupply when price is above threshold
Regulator.step branches to shrinkSupply when price is below threshold
Regulator.step obtains price from oracle().capture()
_updateReserve reads Uniswap pair reserves to size the supply step
growSupply calls _sellAndDepositCollateral
pair.swap is an external callback-capable call made inside the collateral sale loop
_sellAndDepositCollateral mints dollar before selling into pools
_sellAndDepositCollateral transfers dollar into each pool
the len local controls the pool-list loop of _sellAndDepositCollateral
preClaimDollar transfers pending dollar to the user
preClaimDollar uses msg.sender to look up the pool account
the pending local drives the amount transferred in preClaimDollar
deposit pulls LP tokens via IERC20.transferFrom
deposit credits msg.sender staged balance
the value parameter sets the deposit amount
withdraw transfers staged LP tokens back to msg.sender
withdraw decrements msg.sender staged balance
bond calls preClaimDollar before changing balances
unbond calls preClaimDollar before changing balances
provide calls _addLiquidity to add LP
_addLiquidity pulls both tokens via safeTransferFrom
_addLiquidity uses pair.mint and dollar minting paths
purchaseCoupons burns the caller dollar through burnFromAccount
the dollarAmount parameter determines the burned amount and coupon size
burnFromAccountForDebt performs external transferFrom/burn before finishing state updates
burnFromAccountForDebt pulls dollar from the caller account
burnFromAccountForDebt decrements _state.balance.debt
extendCoupon burns dollars for debt via burnFromAccountForDebt
clipCoupons calls clipRedeemedCoupon for the caller
the couponExpireEpoch parameter selects the coupon epoch to clip
clipRedeemedCoupon result is paid out via dollar transfer in clipToAccount
clipRedeemedCoupon zeroes the account coupon entry and updates coupon accounting
redeem performs SafeERC20.safeTransfer external calls to the caller for each collateral asset
redeem sends collateral to msg.sender and pulls rewards from msg.sender
redeem is protected by the nonReentrant guard backed by _status
redeem finishes by burning the caller dollar for debt
redeem reads totalDebt to decide whether redemption is discounted
the value parameter sets the redeem amount and burn size
vote records and locks ballot state for msg.sender
vote requires msg.sender == tx.origin to prevent contract voting
vote compares the ballot window against _state.epoch.current
commit calls upgradeTo after quorum and approval checks
emergencyCommit calls upgradeTo after super-majority checks
the candidate parameter selects which implementation will be upgraded
upgradeTo delegatecalls the candidate implementation and runs its initialize()
commit requires msg.sender to equal the configured governor
pendingReward uses msg.sender as the account index
pendingReward reads pool accounting tied to the current epoch
_getDollarReserve reads pair reserves and token ordering
block.timestamp is consumed by epochTime/blockTimestamp
epochTime returns a timestamp-derived epoch used by bonding and governance
increaseSupply mints new redeemable dollar into _state.balance.redeemable
increaseSupply true-up reads totalCoupons from balance.coupons
the allReserve local computed in step sizes collateral sales
the price local from oracleCapture drives the supply branch
totalAllocPoint weights the per-pool LP reward share in mintToLPs
collateralRatio scales the minted amount in growSupply
SafeERC20 optional-return handling may fall into raw call paths
reserve reads precede the swap sizing in the collateral sale loop

normalization_plan.reason: value is a transient function parameter for deposit/withdraw/bond/unbond and has no independent security identity
dollarAmount is a transient parameter whose effect is fully captured by purchaseCoupons
value is a transient parameter of redeem and is summarized by the Collateral.redeem core node
candidate is a transient parameter selecting the implementation in commit/emergencyCommit
couponExpireEpoch is a transient parameter used only by clipCoupons/extendCoupon
pending is a computed local fully contained in preClaimDollar
allReserve is a computed local fully contained in Regulator.step
len is a loop-bound local fully contained in _sellAndDepositCollateral
price is an oracle-derived local consumed directly by Regulator.step
